Object.Name: EdgeZ WNM Sleep
Object.Description1: Vendor object for one-shot WNM deep sleep while preserving the HaLow association and online DTIM settings. WNM negotiation requires AP support. LwM2M traffic and sensor streaming pause during sleep and resume on wake. An optional low-power accelerometer interrupt can end sleep early. IMU settings persist across reboot and are independent of transport-mode provisioning. Long sleeps may outlive AP association, DHCP or LwM2M registration lifetimes and require recovery.

Item.Name: Sleep
Item.Description: Execute once, without arguments. Returns 2.04 before a two-second grace period, then negotiates WNM Sleep with MM8108 chip powerdown. Requires AP WNM support. Online DTIM configuration is unchanged; DTIM reception is skipped only while WNM sleep is active.

Item.Name: Sleep Duration
Item.Description: Duration after successful WNM entry, 1..86400 seconds. Default 60. Stored in RAM until reboot. Changes and repeated Executes are rejected while a sleep request is pending.

Item.Name: Sleep State
Item.Description: 0 idle, 1 pending, 2 sleeping, 3 waking. Resources are unreachable while asleep. The nRF54L15 retains RAM and waits for the timer or an enabled IMU interrupt.

Item.Name: Last Result
Item.Description: 0 success; positive values are Morse mmwlan_status codes; negative values are local errno values. Execute acceptance does not guarantee AP sleep negotiation succeeded.

Item.Name: Completed Sleep Cycles
Item.Description: Number of successful WNM entries followed by an exit attempt since boot.

Item.Name: Last Entry Time
Item.Description: Time spent negotiating the most recent WNM entry attempt.

Item.Name: Last Exit Time
Item.Description: Time spent in the most recent WNM exit attempt.

Item.Name: Last Sleep Time
Item.Description: Measured interval from successful WNM entry to exit start, excluding negotiation time.

Item.Name: IMU Wake Mode
Item.Description: 0 disabled (default, timer only); 1 motion; 2 six-direction orientation. Saved persistently. Changes are accepted only while idle. The first timer or IMU event ends sleep; no gyroscope verification or BLE provisioning is started.

Item.Name: IMU Motion Threshold
Item.Description: Default 500 mg. Motion mode uses a slope-filtered acceleration interrupt on any axis, rounded upward to a hardware step of 31.25 mg at +/-2 g full scale. Saved persistently. Not the two-axis transport-mode validation threshold.

Item.Name: IMU Orientation Threshold
Item.Description: Default 60 degrees. Six-direction hardware classification threshold relative to gravity, not a relative rotation angle measured from the initial pose. Saved persistently.

Item.Name: Last Wake Reason
Item.Description: 0 none since latest Execute; 1 timer; 2 IMU motion; 3 IMU orientation. A latched IMU event takes priority if the timer expires simultaneously.

Object.Description2: 31026 is an EdgeZ vendor object identifier; this is not a registered OMA standard object.
